algorithm.surface: actual authored ground mesh triangles via Blender BVH; heightJson is not used to invent a hit
algorithm.gapDefinition: bboxMinY minus highest actual support terrain triangle under the AABB bottom-center; if center misses, median actual lower-vertex support hits are used and identified; corners/grid misses are explicit; negative means penetration
algorithm.footprintGrid: 7x7 diagnostic samples; misses remain null and never become zero
algorithm.backdropPolicy: background cliff must be outside playable AABB by threshold; explicitly named background island tree may instead qualify by center distance >=40m with fog context; ordinary tree_small_02 trees remain grounded; ocean plane is background_surface, never a backdrop prop or support
algorithm.acceptance: grounded positive gap <= threshold; negative gap is allowed soil penetration and is counted separately as embedded

tierScope.ultra: not re-exported this round; existing ultra pack unchanged and requires later TOS/master handling

B confirmed pre-repair (height.json sampled source ground through a padded/offset scale chain, up to +10.85m vs visual GLB); repaired by regenerating height.json via 257^2 raycast of the shipped GLB ground mesh; post-repair max |visual-heightJson| = 0.0152m.
